name: Distraction
description: Because of the creature’s alien and forbidding aura, any spellcaster within 20 feet of the creature must make a successful DC 14 spellcasting check before casting a spell; if the check fails, they lose their action but not the spell slot. They must also make a successful DC 14 spellcasting check to maintain concentration if they spend any part of their turn inside the aura.
